name: palm-trunk-to-atlantis
label: Palm Jumeirah → Atlantis The Palm
description: Demo drive from the Palm Jumeirah pin: up the trunk on Palm Jumeirah Road, through the tunnel to the crescent and round to Atlantis The Palm, then a short stop. Starts on the outbound bridge onto the trunk (OSM way 481285845, oneway) so it snaps to the right carriageway.
